observation.text: Northgate Logistics Partners is a value-add industrial fund targeting the acquisition and repositioning of infill logistics and outdoor-storage assets in high-growth Sun Belt and Mountain-West markets. The strategy focuses on lease-up, mark-to-market of below-market rents, and selective development completion.
